title: Sligo Triathlon: Women's Try-A-Tri Initiative
descriptions: Join the Sligo Triathlon club for their Women's Try-A-Tri initiative, designed for women 35 years and older who want to take on the challenge of a triathlon. With a 6-week training program, you'll learn to swim, cycle, and run, and culminate in a full triathlon event on September 27th.
goals: Learn to swim, cycle, and run
Meet new people and build confidence
